hooks.command: file="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS"; ext="${file##*.}"; if [ "$ext" = "ts" ] || [ "$ext" = "tsx" ] || [ "$ext" = "js" ] || [ "$ext" = "jsx" ]; then npx eslint --fix "$file" 2>/dev/null; fi; true
file="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS"; case "$file" in *.env*|*credentials*|*secret*) echo 'BLOCKED: Cannot edit sensitive files directly' >&2; exit 1;; *) exit 0;; esac
